notes.title: Beta 1.1.0 - Coming End of January (big update, technical issues too)
notes.notes:
[b]Been having technical issues to deal with that have slowed me down. Sorry for the delays. It will be soon.

UPDATE:
Still dealing with technical issues but working through them. Focusing on VR now and fixing whatever strange glitches the new Unreal Engine has caused.
Just got through with dealing with a bunch of lightmap and gpu lightmass glitches with Unreal Engine that took forever to solve but are over now.
Future updates won't take this long and once this is out, I can resume the regular one a month schedule. Sorry for the delays.
[/b]

Maps:
[list]
[*] Upgrading from Unreal Engine 5.0 to Unreal Engine 5.1, which will allow the use of nanite without giant chunks of the game becoming incompatible with VR. This will make Kyoto Dreams VR compatible and will mean the game is overall more optimized. This might help stabilize the game on 10 series graphics cards.
[*] Will include the new District #3 of The Poolrooms which is the largest Poolrooms map to date and will feature a fully fleshed out underwater labyrinth.
[*] District #2 of The Poolrooms has been expanded with a new area.
[*] New texture for the surface of water when viewed from underwater.
[*] Kyoto Dreams has received an expansion and looks beautiful.
[*] A preview for Level 0.1
[/list]

Weapons:
[list]
[*] Improvements to the ammunition system; Guns will each have different ammo types and separate ammo counters.
[*] Guns will now do a different amount of damage based on range.
[*] Each gun will deal a different amount of damage overall.
[*] Guns will now take time to reload instead of it being instant and there will be a reload animation.
[*] New Gun SFX.
[*] Sawed Off Shotgun added.
[*] Bolt-Action Rifle added.
[*] Two new Automatic Assault Rifles added.
[*] A Firesalt Gun that shoots incendiary ammo added.
[*] A weapon that shoots a sustained laser burst added.
[/list]

Player:
[list]
[*] Can now "Sprint" while swimming.
[*] Small white dot no longer visible in middle of VR (it's used to select items in regular mode)
[*] Crouching added which will open up future possibilities for level design.
[*] You will now receive a notification when drowning and special drowning music will play.
[*] You will now receive a notification when dying of thirst, starving or going insane.
[/list]

Entities:
[list]
[*] Partygoers have been redesigned so they now freeze in place when you are looking and move incredibly fast the moment you look away. They will regularly get the jump on you and you'll know there's one moving off screen by the creaking sound they make.
[/list]

Other:
[list]
[*] Random item cabinets.
[*] Random weapon crates.
[*] FPS lock options to reduce GPU usage.
[*] Main Menu bug fixed where it wouldn't let you use the mouse to click the buttons.
[/list]

notes.title: Small update coming soon - Beta 1.0.4
notes.notes:
I wanted to do a little update by November 3rd at the latest.
This update will include:

[list]
[*] A full version of Level -1 'Glitched Halls', including a level survival guide.
[*] A full version of Level -1.1 'Inverted', including a level survival guide.
[*] An additional room added to Kyoto Dreams and some new models for the level.
[*] New underwater areas in The Poolrooms.
[*] Added physics based swimming pool floats that are in some areas of the Poolrooms.
[*] Vending machines for Liquid Breath and Energy Bars.
[*] The new items from last update are now scattered around the levels.
[*] Fixes another inventory bug that I found
[*] Fixes the bug where in VR if you use the pointer while holding a gun, it makes the torch appear when you stop using the pointer.
[*] Adds musical jingles to all of the vending machine types.
[*] Improves Level Fun sound design.
[*] I can't remember if I did this last update or this update, but in the VR Main Menu, the menu no longer follows your eye so you can more easily read it.
[*] Updated the credits.
[*] Updated the version number in the main menu which I forgot to do last time.
[/list]

notes.title: Update coming soon with several fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
I'm planning on releasing a new update in about a week or so with some general fixes and improvements.
These include:
[list]
[*] With all the new maps being made, the RAM requirement got larger and larger. Some of the Levels have been splintered off into separate maps, which should decrease load times and make the game use less RAM. There will now be elevators to take you between the three maps.
[*] A functioning Sanity mechanic with auditory hallucinations and visual effects.
[*] Improvements to the Smiler Entity including: It should now stay in the dark and new placeholder animations.
[*] Improvements to the Partygoer Entity including: More menacing sound design and increased size.
[*] New gameplay option to disable guns.
[*] New gameplay option to change the difficulty of survival mechanics.
[*] The option to disable entities has been expanded to include difficulty options for entities.
[*] I've increased the frequency of level unloading so the game will use less RAM.
[*] Fixed a bug where you wouldn't die if you ran out of health from hunger or thirst.
[*] The drowning mechanic is now fully functional so don't stay underwater too long!
[*] Level Fun has received an expansion with new rooms and some old rooms getting a redesign.
[*] Adds planned upcoming levels to the main menu so you can see a preview of the level and its description.
[*] Possibly more.
[/list]
